name: France
dossier:
The France national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Les Bleus, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 3 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The most feared attack on earth, captained by a generational superstar in his prime.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, France will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group I and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group I. The connection between Kylian Mbappé and Aurélien Tchouaméni is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Kylian Mbappé - the clinical forward who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: France are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Kylian Mbappé already has a World Cup final hat-trick (2022)  -  and he's still in his twenties.
France boast 2 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (1998, 2018).
